name: Paid Ads
headline: paid-ads: Optimize Your Ad Campaigns
short_description: You are an expert performance marketer with direct access to ad platform accounts. Your goal is to help create, optimize, and scale paid advertising campaigns that drive efficient customer acquisition.
author: coreyhaines31

sections.overview: The paid-ads skill is designed for performance marketers seeking to enhance their paid advertising campaigns. By providing direct access to ad platform accounts, this skill enables users to create, optimize, and scale campaigns effectively. It leverages AI automation to streamline the process, making it easier to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously and adjust strategies based on real-time data. This results in more efficient customer acquisition and maximizes return on ad spend. One of the key benefits of the paid-ads skill is its ability to save time in campaign management. With automation handling routine tasks such as bid adjustments and performance monitoring, marketers can focus on strategic decision-making and creative aspects of their campaigns. This skill is particularly valuable for product managers and marketing teams who need to quickly adapt to changing market conditions while ensuring that their advertising efforts remain effective and profitable. Marketers in various roles, especially those in digital marketing and growth teams, will find the paid-ads skill beneficial. It is ideal for those responsible for managing advertising budgets and optimizing campaigns for maximum impact. For instance, a digital marketing manager could use this skill to automate the analysis of ad performance metrics, allowing them to reallocate budget towards the best-performing ads more efficiently. Additionally, it can be utilized by AI practitioners looking to integrate advanced automation into their marketing workflows. While the implementation difficulty and specific requirements are currently unknown, the skill is designed to fit seamlessly into AI-first workflows, enhancing the capabilities of any marketing team. By incorporating the paid-ads skill into their toolkit, organizations can ensure they stay ahead in the competitive landscape of digital marketing, leveraging AI automation to drive better results with less manual effort.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.

### Google Ads Setup Checklist

- [ ] Conversion tracking installed and tested
- [ ] Google Analytics 4 linked
- [ ] Audience lists created (remarketing, customer match)
- [ ] Negative keyword lists built
- [ ] Ad extensions set up (sitelinks, callouts, structured snippets)
- [ ] Brand campaign running (protect branded terms)
- [ ] Competitor campaign considered
- [ ] Location and language targeting set
- [ ] Ad schedule aligned with business hours (if B2B)

### Meta Ads Setup Checklist

- [ ] Pixel installed and events firing
- [ ] Conversions API set up (server-side tracking)
- [ ] Custom audiences created
- [ ] Product catalog connected (if e-commerce)
- [ ] Domain verified
- [ ] Business Manager properly configured
- [ ] Aggregated event measurement prioritized
- [ ] Creative assets in correct sizes
- [ ] UTM parameters in all URLs

### LinkedIn Ads Setup Checklist

- [ ] Insight Tag installed
- [ ] Conversion tracking configured
- [ ] Matched audiences created
- [ ] Company page connected
- [ ] Lead gen form templates created
- [ ] Document assets uploaded (for Document Ads)
- [ ] Audience size validated (not too narrow)
- [ ] Budget realistic for LinkedIn CPCs ($8-15+)
